# AI-MarkDone

AI-MarkDone is a focused ChatGPT browser extension for Reader mode, source-aware Markdown copy, LaTeX formula copy/export, Dynamic Annotation, bookmarks, Google Drive bookmark backup, and Markdown/PDF/PNG export without leaving the original ChatGPT workflow.

## Personal Website

- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ and https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/en/ - Liangbin Zhao: research, writing, and independent software.
- /research/ and /en/research/ - Publications, reproducible research and code.
- /writing/ and /en/writing/ - Technical notes and essays. Chinese articles retain /notes/ URLs; full English translations use /en/notes/.
- /projects/ and /en/projects/ - AI-MarkDone and Mappamory. Mappamory (好友迹, 你的好友地图通讯录) links to its standalone website at https://mappamory.com.

## Core Pages

- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/ - Chinese independent product site for AI-MarkDone, a ChatGPT browser extension with a product interface composition, interactive Reader, copy/export, and bookmark workflow, grouped manual index, local-first trust notes, real user feedback and acknowledgements, and Chrome/Firefox install links.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/ - English independent product site for AI-MarkDone with the same ChatGPT positioning, Reader, copy/export, and bookmark workflow, real product imagery, grouped manual index, privacy disclosure, and install links.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/manual/ - Chinese manual overview introducing AI-MarkDone as a ChatGPT workbench, with four goal cards, a need-to-feature matrix, and Reader/settings CTAs before the detailed manual sections.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/manual/ - English manual overview with the same four goal cards, need-to-feature matrix, and Reader/settings CTAs before the detailed manual sections.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/manual/architecture/ - Chinese plugin architecture manual centered on one interactive workflow map that shows how AI-MarkDone discovers ChatGPT content, prepares shared answer data, and routes it into Reader, copy, bookmarks, export, formulas, settings, backup, and message navigation.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/manual/architecture/ - English plugin architecture manual with the same single interactive workflow map and no separate path index.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/manual/message-navigation/ - Chinese manual page for message navigation, lower-right message buttons, arrow-key switching, and restoring the reading position after sending.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/manual/message-navigation/ - English manual page for message navigation, lower-right message buttons, arrow-key switching, and restoring the reading position after sending.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/manual/copy-markdown/ - Chinese manual page for Copy Markdown, covering full-answer copy, Reader partial copy, the Markdown conversion path, cleanup rules, and supported Markdown syntax.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/manual/copy-markdown/ - English manual page for Copy Markdown, covering full-answer copy, Reader partial copy, the Markdown conversion path, cleanup rules, and supported Markdown syntax.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/features/ - Chinese feature reference page with quick links into the current manual.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/features/ - English feature reference page with quick links into the current manual.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/faq/ - Chinese FAQ covering ChatGPT support, Reader, partial Markdown copy, formulas, Dynamic Annotation, bookmarks, export, Google Drive backup, privacy, pricing, and settings.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/faq/ - English FAQ covering ChatGPT support, Reader mode, partial Markdown copy, formulas, Dynamic Annotation, bookmarks, export, Google Drive backup, privacy, pricing, and settings.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/privacy/ - Chinese privacy policy explaining local processing, browser extension storage, optional Google Drive bookmark backup, permissions, no owned server, no analytics, and Google API Limited Use commitments.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/privacy/ - English privacy policy with the same Google Drive backup, permissions, and Limited Use disclosures for review and user reference.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/contact/ - Chinese contact page for email feedback and GitHub Issues.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/contact/ - English contact page for email feedback and GitHub Issues.

- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/workflow/ - Chinese guide to Reader, Markdown/formula copy and export, and bookmarks.
- https://zhaoliangbin42.github.io/ai-markdone/en/workflow/ - Corresponding English workflow.
- /ai-markdone/guide/install/ and /ai-markdone/guide/reader/ (also /ai-markdone/en/guide/...) redirect to the existing manual pages.
